name: cloudflare-publish
description: Publish local web apps, APIs, or machine-only SSH from macOS or Linux through Cloudflare Tunnel.

interface.shortDescription: Share local apps from Mac or Linux
interface.longDescription: Give a local web app, API, authenticated callback, or existing SSH server a stable hostname from macOS or Linux. The agent uses the separately installed cloudflare-publish CLI to plan changes, manage Access, verify routes, and recover interrupted work. Requires shell execution on that host, cloudflared, your own Cloudflare account with an active full DNS zone and API token; Linux also requires systemd user services and operator-arranged lingering. Each host/profile owns a distinct tunnel. SSH is machine-only with a trusted Ed25519 host-key pin, client-side cloudflared, and separate SSH login credentials. Installing or removing guidance does not create, stop, or retire publications.
defaultPrompt: Use Cloudflare Publish to plan a protected hostname for my local web app.
Use Cloudflare Publish to inspect my tunnel manager and explain the next safe action.
